title: Occurrence of novel human tomato brown rugose fruit virus and conventional microbial source tracking genetic markers in a Hawaiian coupled stream-beach system
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00373C, Paper
Sarah A. Lowry, Adam Diedrich, Ella Lum, Orin C. Shanks, Alexandria B. Boehm
This study uses microbial source tracking methods and employs a novel human fecal marker to identify the sources of fecal contamination in a coupled stream-beach system.
